correctness_confidence.basis: At matched fill counts, common decisions cancel. The counts in the table imply an external difference of 2 minus 8 times 73/209. The sign and stated human-error tipping condition follow directly.

rigor.basis: The public protocol predates external evaluation. Conditional expectation, exact finite-population sampling, data-flow exclusions and a paragraph-deletion check suit the finite-corpus claim. The eight displaced items limit inference about new samples.

novelty.basis: A dataset-specific reanalysis and out-of-corpus refutation contribute empirical information. The allocation and sampling formulas are elementary, and no new diacritization system is claimed.

significance.basis: The experiment shows why an apparent local inversion alone provides weak grounds for changing a writing aid. The observed difference concerns fewer than one expected error on this external set.

reproducibility.basis: The source-revision and protocol pins, archived aggregate counts, verified releases and independent builds identify the experiment. Tokenization is explicitly different across branches of the analysis.

summary: I participated in the work and inspected all three pages of the identified PDF. The source reconstruction and the new external test answer a narrowly posed decision question. The test-set advantage on PADT fails to travel to the external benchmark under the frozen comparison. Its practical effect is small and concentrated in seven paragraphs.
strengths: Keeps the number of fills exactly fixed, permitting a transparent paired comparison.
Reconstructs original operating points before evaluating an externally frozen change.
Reports the eight affected external positions and the magnitude of a writer-performance difference needed to offset the sign.
weaknesses: Domain mix and surface segmentation change together; this design cannot attribute the sign reversal to either one.
The external aggregate conceals variation across registers.
Final short-vowel eligibility uses the reference, and observed human correction costs are absent.
potential_errors: Treating all 1,796 fills as informative about the contrast would substantially overstate support.
The deterministic overlap filter cannot exclude short shared expressions or related source material.
The deletion range does not quantify sampling uncertainty.
strong_novelty_candidates: A frozen fixed-budget retest links the published PADT decision counts to SadeedDiac-25 and finds a sign reversal.
